summary: A wavetable synth firmware built around single-cycle waves you draw on the FM-1: shape Waves A and B, morph between them, and use Wave C to modulate the result.
features: Draw 128-point waves with three brushes; 16-step undo and redo
Shape morph of A and B, audio-rate 'WAVE AMP', four-route mod matrix
Up to eight shared voices; GROUPS keyboard splits, macros and scenes
ARP with 'RIFF' generator; sequencer up to 256 steps with locks
64 wave, 32 preset and 4 project slots; USB MIDI notes and clock
Not yet fully tested on physical hardware

headings: three different kinds of saved data
core project and directly derived foundation
additional upstream projects and attribution inventory
